doctorVerification.title: Doctor Verification
doctorVerification.documentsRequiredDescription: Please upload the following documents to verify your veterinary license:
doctorVerification.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this document?
doctorVerification.verificationRequiredDescription: Please upload your verification documents to complete your profile and start accepting appointments.
doctorVerification.verificationInProgressDescription: Your documents are being reviewed. You'll be notified once the verification is complete.
doctorVerification.verificationApprovedDescription: Congratulations! Your verification has been approved. You can now start accepting appointments.
doctorVerification.verificationRejectedDescription: Your verification documents were not approved. Please upload new documents or contact support.
doctorVerification.verificationGuidanceText: Please ensure your documents are clear, valid, and contain all required information. Documents should be in good quality and all text should be clearly readable.
doctorVerification.licenseRequirementsText: Your veterinary license must be valid and issued by the relevant veterinary authority in your country/region.
doctorVerification.degreeRequirementsText: Your veterinary degree certificate should show your name, degree title, institution, and graduation date.
doctorVerification.idRequirementsText: Your national ID or passport should be valid and clearly show your name, photo, and identification number.
doctorVerification.documentQualityTipsText: Ensure good lighting, avoid shadows, keep documents flat, and make sure all text is clearly visible.
doctorVerification.verificationTimelineText: Verification typically takes 1-3 business days. You'll receive an email notification once the process is complete.
doctorVerification.privacyNoticeText: Your documents are securely stored and used only for verification purposes. They will be kept confidential and not shared with third parties.

auth.verificationBlockedDescription: Please complete your document verification to access your account.
auth.loginBlockedDescription: Your account is pending verification. Please upload your documents to proceed.
auth.verificationPendingDescription: Please wait while we verify your documents. This usually takes 1-3 business days.
auth.verificationFailedDescription: Your verification was not successful. Please contact support or try again with new documents.
